description: This file defines the web interface for the Wi-Fi configuration step (wizard_step2.php). It includes HTML, JavaScript for form validation and interactivity, PHP code to retrieve Wi-Fi settings and populate form fields, and logic to handle user inputs for configuring Wi-Fi network names, security modes, and passwords for both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends the JSON configuration data via AJAX to save the Wi-Fi settings and handles the server response.

methods.name: addslashes
methods.description: Escapes backslashes and quotes in a string for safe inclusion in JSON or JavaScript code.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Gathers form data, constructs a JSON configuration string, and initiates the save process via set_config().
